title: TKT Framework Lesson Stager
description: Generates complete lesson plan templates for PPP, TBL (Willis), ESA (Harmer), and 3Ps frameworks with timing, activity types, error correction guidance, and CCQ/ICQ builder. Aligned to Cambridge TKT framework expectations.
regulatory_citations: Harmer, J. (2007). The Practice of English Language Teaching, 4th ed. Pearson Longman.
Willis, J. (1996). A Framework for Task-Based Learning. Longman.
Cambridge Assessment English. (2023). TKT Teaching Knowledge Test Handbook.
